game_concept: A card battler set in Coastal Port – Cannon Battery, the harbor cannon battery: the deckhand must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Branching Tale: Make story choices that run different if/elif branches toward different endings.
theme: Coastal Port – Cannon Battery: the harbor cannon battery
core_gameplay_loop: In Cannon Battery, repeat each round: Make story choices that run different if/elif branches toward different endings. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the story_trust value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about story_trust to power up the deckhand and open the ship's hull.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 1 (intro tier): Branching Tale
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Branching Tale' (Week 3 slot 12), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Cannon Battery'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how story_trust changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Cannon Battery.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
